sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Simple sequencing expressions such as *reggel*, délben, délután and *este* help organise a routine.

items.english: I get up in the morning.
I go to bed in the evening.

sections.content: délben uses a different ending pattern than reggel/délután/este — that -ben is the same ‘inside’ suffix family from -ban/-ben you met earlier, because dél (‘noon’) is being treated almost like a point you’re ‘in.’ Not every time word grammaticalizes the same way, which is worth noticing rather than memorizing blind.
